question: How many newspapers (copies, all editions combined) are sold in India daily?
idealClarificationQuestions: All languages including English, Hindi, regional? All.
Includes free subscription distributions? No — paid + circulating only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: From major publishers' circulation data + small/local papers.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top Hindi dailies: Dainik Bhaskar (~5.5M), Dainik Jagran (~5.5M), Hindustan (~5M), Amar Ujala (~3M), Punjab Kesari (~2M), Rajasthan Patrika (~2M) = ~23M Hindi.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top regional: Malayala Manorama (~2M), Eenadu (~1.5M), Mathrubhumi (~1M), Daily Thanthi (~2M), Sakal, Loksatta, ABP, Sambad, etc. = ~15-20M regional.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Note: declining ~5-7%/year due to digital shift; pre-COVID was ~70M.
